newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Sema coverage.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Sema coverage.

text.p: Sema Group Plc was added to Goldman Sachs' European recommended list as the brokerage began coverage of the computer services group, market sources said on Thursday.
The stock was up 5p at 983-1/2 by 1204 GMT, after earlier reaching a record 987p -- pulled higher by a jump in rival Logica Plc, up 27-1/2p at 889 after a French acquisition.

Sema shares have surged over the past year on the back of hopes for strong earnings growth in the sector. Since September 1995, when they were trading below 400p, the shares have more than doubled in value.
In September Sema posted a 23.6 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profit to 19.75 million stg and said its order book had grown 31 percent to 991 million stg since the end of 1995.
Goldman analysts were not immediately available for comment. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
